listing.aiSummary: Adds enhanced Kite ship designs, including Super, Mega, Mini, and Uber variants, along with specialized weapons.

description:
Prismatic Kites

Imagine a genius engineer who became obsessed with a single ship design. Lo and behold, the Kite Crafter.

Adds enhanced Kite designs and other things.

Download

Github

Super Kites:

Spoiler
Kites that have been completely overhauled and revamped. Essentially new ships that look like Kites.

Vermillion

Missiles on a Kite are cool. More missiles are cooler

Gamboge

A speedy ship shredder that strafes and shoots quite well for its size.

Citrine

The Kite turned anti-fighter, it houses its own Mini-Kites to fight off enemy fighters.

Verdant

A lean, green, anti-missile machine. It packs a supreme amount of flares.

Cerulean

Hosts Mini-Kite support and a Medium Energy Support to serve as a support ship or blaster.

Indigo

The Kite made into a Phase Ship, popping in and out of p-space.

Lavender

Built to give a laser light show.

Hazel

Kites look big planes. and planes can give ground support. Therefore, the Hazel.

Destroyers in the shape of Kites. Most are fusions of Super Kites.

Mega Kites:

Spoiler
Mega-Kite

Imagine a Kite, but one class bigger.

Mega-Kite (Freighter)

Imagine a Mega-Kite, but logistics.

Canna Lily

Combining the Vermillion and Gamboge, the Canna Lily unleashes ballistics and missiles upon its enemies.

Delphinium

Combining the Cerulean and Indigo, the Delphinium Phase ship hosts a decent amount of firepower for its size.

Gaillardia

Combining the Vermillion and the Citrine, the Gaillardia wields only two weapon slots, but natively fields the Square class Mini-Kite.

Hydrangeas

Combining the Verdant and Cerulean, the Hydrangeas is a more balanced ship that can switch between a more offensive fit or serve and a defensive escort.

Osteospermum

Combining the Gamboge and Lavender, the Osteospermum's Temporal Shell lets it unload its array of energy and ballistic weaponry.

Mini-Kites:

Spoiler
Fighter drones shaped like Kites.

Dot

A Mini-Kite that can essentially fly off on its own.

Line

A Mini-Kite with no weapons, but an EMP system that zaps enemies.

Triangle

Essentially a Broadsword shaped like a Kite, but also has missiles instead of more guns.

Square

A cheap pack of drones that throws missiles at the enemy.

Uber Kites:

Spoiler
Kites that have been highly specialized and enhanced.

Sable

A Phase Kite that specializes in utilizing its Kite Termination Sequence to overwhelm and destroy its enemies.

Alabaster

A highly versatile, if limited, Kite design that holds the Piercing Light system, allowing it to shoot through the battlefield and any ships in its way.

Weapons:

Spoiler
Micro-Kite Sling

Shoots guided Micro-Kites that crash into the enemy.

Micro-Kite Rocket Sling

Shoots unguided Micro-Kites loaded with explosives.

Kite Beam

A Kite shaped laser gun that shoots bursts of lasers.

Changelog:

Spoiler
v0.2.3
SAVE COMPATIBLE
-changed spawn rates of Mini-Kites in the market (wow they were low, woops)
-added variants and spawn weights for Mega-Kite and Mega-Kite (Freighter)
-lowered prices of Mega-Kite and Freighter ver to 20,000
-added civilian to Mega-Kite Freighter
-lowered rarity rates of Super and Mega Kite lines (made them slightly more rarer)
-increased supplies/month for Mega-Kite Freighter from 4 to 5
-adjusted variant weights to actually make sense (i misread how they were used)
-changed kite ground support hullmod to tier 1 and added tags
-changed rarity values for kite hullmods to be rarer
-changed Mega-Kite line speed values

v0.2.2
SAVE COMPATIBLE
-adjusted stats for Mega Kite and Mega Kite Freighter
--lowered ordinance points, hull points, armor, max flux, top speed, d-mod cost, hull cost, crew sal mult,
-fixed KiteMissileOverhaul hullmod tooltip
-deleted extra osteospermum ship file
-fixed fatal crash when looking at Kite Ballistic Overhaul tooltip (can't have more than ten format specifiers :(. )
-removed duplicate Kite entry in the hull.csv

v0.2.1
SAVE COMPATIBLE
-forgot to actually give the new ships spawn rates in the ship roles lol added them in
-added variants for some of the mega kites

v0.2.0
SAVE INCOMPATIBLE
had to change id of the square mini-kite and changed names of wing ids to be more in line with vanilla naming conventions
sorry

-added the mega kite line
-added two uber kites
-added special kite hullmods only for kites (non altered designs)
-added version file
-nerfed Square Mini-Kite by changing missile slots to Hammer Single and changed stats

v0.1.1
-Updated paths and text details
-Added a new weapon
-Rebalanced some things

---

v0.1.0
-First iteration of the mod
-10 new Kite forms (8 frigates, 2 destroyers)
-2 weapons

First mod. Made by following the wiki modding tutorial and copying base game things.
Very open to balance changes.

AI Disclaimer
Not sure if this counts, but I did ask Google for specific methods and the AI got them.
